predictions.rationale: Primary class that defines the UML Collaboration Diagram type, its behavior, and integration with the diagram framework.
Graph model that manages the underlying semantic model elements and their connections specifically for collaboration diagrams.
Responsible for visual rendering of collaboration diagram elements (objects, links, messages) onto the canvas.
Handles initialization/registration of collaboration diagram type within ArgoUML, crucial for feature availability.
Provides the property panel (UI) for collaboration diagrams, directly supporting user interaction with the feature.
UI action that creates a new collaboration diagram; key entry point for users to invoke the feature.
Explorer navigation rule that maps operations to collaboration diagrams, aiding users in locating related diagrams.
Explorer rule connecting projects to collaboration model elements/diagrams, facilitating access to the feature.
Navigator rule that links collaboration model elements to their diagrams, directly supporting collaboration diagram usage.
Represents the meta-model or model-level abstraction of a collaboration diagram, foundational for the feature’s data layer.
